qualified_actual_public_models.full_10000_test: Completed and independently audited: FP32 9349/10000; declared integer plus actual E5 feedback9345/10000;104 changed predictions; every24576000000 local leakage result exactly scalar-equal; see cifar10_full10000_a0/results.json and benchmark_acceptance.json.
qualified_actual_public_models.integer_conversion: FP32 synapses/readout; RNE effective currents to unit1/256; ceil(128U/256); threshold256 equality fires; immediate subtractive reset256
qualified_actual_public_models.packing_policy: Common zero bypass; retain original neuron order; greedy adjacent same-beta signed9 pairs, exact fullwidth singleton otherwise
qualified_actual_public_models.width_policy: Original B12 rejects real wide states. Root accepted a fixed B16 fullwidth extension without changing model units or coefficients. Fullwidth applicability requires all old leakage operands AND every stored post-reset state to fit signed16. Exhaustive per-layer min/max proves zero stored-state exceptions when in bounds; any violation is unsupported, not clipped.

claim_boundaries: Exact integer-vs-packed equality establishes packing preservation. Original-FP32-vs-integer differences establish conversion impact.
This is not a fully quantized SNN: synaptic convolutions, normalization and output readout remain FP32.
Counts are primitive scheduling estimates, not accelerator throughput, host inference speed, board power or energy measurements.
Driver operand sample is ordered stress coverage from actual model execution, not an unbiased energy sample.
Sharing a benchmark dataset with FireFly does not establish equal hardware architecture, neuron units or accelerator performance.
